thesis: PLMR is a fundamentally strong, accelerating P&C insurer in a clean uptrend, and it is defying a risk-off tape. Revenue growth is accelerating and the post-earnings base has held on heavy volume. Insurance is not part of the tech/semis selloff, and the next earnings date is outside the swing window, so the catalyst risk is low. This is a real but modest setup, not a high-conviction one. The stock is overbought (RSI 74), R/R is only about 2.0, and the regime is hostile, so a pullback entry in the 163.5-167.0 zone with reduced size is the only sensible way to own it.
